geometry_bands.source_anchor: Channeled jet directed at target ('Channel to unleash the souls of the dead in a hellish torrent!', 'a channeled jet of horrid flames'); sustained directional stream covering a cone in front of the Warlock. Geometry = CONE per hot-fact geo-erratum ('channeled jet'/'hellish torrent' -> cone-projection reading; erratum pending). element_primary=shadow (necrotic register), secondary=fire ('both fire and necrotic damage over time'). NO status ailment emitted: 'fire and necrotic damage over time' names damage-TYPE-over-time, not a NAMED status (§0.1 fire != burn; strict m02 frostburn/electrocute precedent) — withheld.

Applied to bosses as an aura-debuff via Signet of Agony (fetched: 'Bone Curse is used as an aura with Signet of Agony'). The curse-APPLICATION-as-aura is fetched, but NO curse EFFECT (amplify/weaken/decrepify/sap) is fetched -> curse variant WITHHELD per §2 shape-silent rule + §0.4 (skill NAME != status/effect attestation). Recorded as a curse-aura rider without a pinned variant.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Channeled cone-jet DoT maps as cone (hot-fact geo-erratum) + channel tick-cost economy; PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_uptime T4 for the sustained-channel DoT identity. Defensive damage-reduction-while-channeling (Disdain) recorded as a trait rider — the channel is unusually a DEFENSIVE stance ('with proper investment you can shrug off even the mightiest of blows'). verify_ledger 1.1 restamp governs cost (48, not 40). §0 near-misses (TWO, notable): (1) burn/fire-DoT WANTED ('fire damage over time') but not a NAMED status -> WITHHELD (strict §0.1); (2) necrotic-DoT has no registry home (drain requires leech/decay language, not present) -> WITHHELD; (3) Bone Curse curse:variant WITHHELD (no effect fetched, shape-silent §2). Element carries all three flavors; the DoT-ness is captured by geometry+economy, not by an ailment token. [STEWARD 2026-07-18: grade APPROX->CLOSE per the damage-type-over-time ruling (m04 addendum); withholds all UPHELD — burn, necrotic-DoT (no registry home), curse-variant (shape-silent §2).]
